item.title: 2026 Aspitations and a brief reflection of what was last year.
item.description:
It’s true that I may or may not accomplish what im about to menction right now, however, I want to keep a record of them so my future self can pressure themself into getting an extra mile.

Last year was a rollercoaster of emotions and overall, experiences. Completing a fucking diploma programme in kamikaze mode and somehow surviving it gave me a good overview of a worst case scenario of collage (I’ve been told is the other way around. I may retract my words later). I know it’s ironical to say that a kamikaze survived but you get the thing. I got love, I got hate, i got war declarations and love again, yet what matters the most is how I was able to manage all of these things while keeping up with a mentally demanding curriculum. Lucky me, the programme is over, but now i’m studying to get accepted in CS and thats hard as hell as well but, i’ve been in worse.

item.title: My First Post & Blog
item.description:
Hello world! I’ve been thinking about creating a blog since I started my website. So I discovered this framework to build static websites called Hugo. I’m using, by the way, a theme called “Hugo blog awesome”, created by Sid. You can find it on his Github - his theme is credited on the footer!

Yesterday I found this little article about “Setting up a blog on Cloudflare Pages” written by Sapico. It was a bit of a trouble to set up the page since hugo wasn’t rendering locally and the deployment took a bit at first, but now I managed to get the theme working at least locally, and I’ll if it work publishing this post.
